title: Praise and Worship Bible Crossword Puzzle — Free on iOS
heading: The Praise and Worship Bible Crossword
description: Solve a praise and worship Bible crossword: the joyful noise, the rock of our salvation, timbrel and harp. KJV clues from the Psalms, free on iOS.
prose: This one is about the act of worship rather than any single psalm — the kneeling, the singing, the noise. Praise and Worship draws its clues from across the Psalter: the joyful noise unto the rock of our salvation, coming before his presence with thanksgiving, and every instrument the psalms hand out — timbrel, harp, psaltery, cymbals, the trumpet.
If you would rather have the psalms as songs than worship as a subject, the archive also holds Songs of Praise, which is a different grid. This one closes on the call that opens Psalm 95.

clues.text: “O come, let us ___ unto the LORD”
Make a joyful one unto the rock of our salvation

verseText: O come, let us sing unto the LORD: let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.
